g.text: Rendered evidence from captured output
Observed at +0.1842355728149414s — page 1
9:`mcpjam test <file>` runs an MCPJam suite file locally: it connects your MCP servers, drives each case's prompts through a model
, grades the transcript with the same assertions a hosted run uses, and decides the run with the same verdict policy. Bring your o
wn provider key and authenticate the run with MCPJam. With MCPJam-hosted inference it uses your existing CLI login and billing.
19:With results uploads disabled, the start-run request sends only the credential in the authorization header, any MCPJam API head
ers you configure through the SDK's `inference.resolveMcpjam`, project selection, a new run-start ID, client version and surface (
SDK, CLI, or Vitest), planned iteration count, provider names, and whether a client profile is used (`unknown` for custom executor
s). The server resolves the organization and account. The start-run request sends no prompts, outputs, tool calls, or server URLs.
MCPJam-hosted inference still sends prompts through MCPJam to the model, as before. Retries reuse the same ID. Planned iterations
are intent, not completed usage or a charge. This release adds no debit, quota draw, or balance refusal.
132:There is no fallback: a key the provider rejects is a credential failure (exit `3`), never a reason to spend platform credits
instead.
136:MCPJam-hosted inference uses the Cloud credential precedence (`--api-key` > `MCPJAM_API_KEY` > `mcpjam cloud login`) and proje
ct precedence (`--project` > `MCPJAM_PROJECT` > `mcpjam cloud link` > most recently updated), plus `--api-url` / `--api-header`. T
he platform is contacted only when a selected case needs it. Hosted inference still makes inference and billing requests; "no uplo
ad" means no eval results or artifacts are ever sent.
185:Every selected case is checked before any model or tool call, so an unsupported later case costs nothing. Hosted-only capabili
ties run with `mcpjam cloud eval run --file <file>`.
206:| `4` | Setup, connection, tool catalog, binding, interpolation or billing failure, or a report that could not be written |
